title: Identity Facet
description: SDD-R011 §5. Uniquely identifies the Engineering Knowledge Object. Immutable once published -- object_id, uuid, and package_id never change across the object's lifetime; only version and lifecycle_state advance.

object_id.description: Globally unique, dotted, referenced only by this id (SDD-R010 §10).

object_type.description: SDD-R001 §4. Checked against the known Object Type list by the validator (soft, extensible).

display_name.description: May change across revisions -- never used as an identifier (REFERENCE-TASK-000012).

short_name.description: A short, human-friendly name (SDD-R011 §5) -- replaces WORK_PACKAGE_001's canonical_name field.

version.description: Semantic version of this object. Structured major/minor/patch decomposition was a separate section in WORK_PACKAGE_001; SDD-R011 §5 lists only a single Version field on Identity, so this string is now the sole authoritative version -- see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md.

lifecycle_state.description: SDD-R008 §4 lifecycle states. The single authoritative status field -- SDD-R002 §10's Lifecycle classification dimension is represented here, not duplicated under classification (Constitution Article V).

package_id.description: The package this object is authored under -- new in SDD-R011 §5, makes package membership an explicit identity fact rather than only implicit from directory location.

uuid.description: A stable identifier independent of object_id, so a future rename/re-slug of object_id can be tracked as the same underlying object (SDD-R011 §5).
